metadata.description: Short azd environment name used in resource names and tags.
Azure region for the resource group and regional resources.
Stable code derived from the final numeric token of the Azure subscription display name.
Deployment profile. Minimal excludes VMs, Bastion, NAT, and Entra login; full enables them plus shutdown schedules.
Repository identifier applied to common tags.
Optional owner tag. Avoid personal data; prefer a team or service identifier.
Optional cost-center tag.
Creation timestamp seeded once by the azd preprovision hook.
Last-update timestamp refreshed by the azd preprovision hook.
Deploy Standard Azure Bastion. Defaults on for the full profile.
Deploy the Windows 11 Pro jumpbox. Defaults on for the full profile.
Deploy the Ubuntu jumpbox. Defaults on for the full profile.
Enable outbound internet from the jumpbox subnet through a NAT Gateway. Defaults on for full and must be disabled with Entra login for air-gapped deployments.
Install Microsoft Entra login extensions on jumpbox VMs. Defaults on for full and must match the NAT Gateway setting.
Optional MDM application ID passed to AADLoginForWindows. Leave empty for Entra login without automatic MDM enrollment.
Create VM auto-shutdown schedules. Defaults on for the full profile.
Create configured operator RBAC assignments. Disable when the deployer lacks roleAssignments/write.

Base64-encoded JSON object overriding profile feature flags. Supported keys: bastion, windowsVm, linuxVm, natGateway, entraLogin, shutdownSchedules, roleAssignments. natGateway and entraLogin must match.
Comma-separated Entra user or group object IDs that receive VM login and private data-plane roles.
VNet address space. Default subnet parameters are derived from this /22.
Azure Bastion subnet. Azure requires /26 or larger.
Private jumpbox subnet.
Private endpoint subnet.
Windows VM size.
Ubuntu VM size.
Windows 11 Pro Marketplace image.
Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS Marketplace image.
Local Windows break-glass account name.
Local Ubuntu break-glass account name.
Log Analytics retention in days.
Log Analytics daily ingestion cap in GB.
Local auto-shutdown time in HHmm format.
Windows time zone ID used by Azure DevTest Lab auto-shutdown schedules.

variables.keyVaultEnvironmentLength: [max(1, sub(24, length(format('{0}-{1}-{2}--{3}', variables('abbreviations').keyVault, variables('locationCode'), parameters('subscriptionCode'), variables('shortUniqueSuffix')))))]
variables.commonTags: [union(createObject('repository', parameters('repository'), 'azd-env-name', parameters('environmentName'), 'environment', parameters('environmentName'), 'profile', parameters('deploymentProfile'), 'managed-by', 'azd', 'created-on', parameters('createdOn'), 'last-updated-on', parameters('lastUpdatedOn')), if(empty(parameters('owner')), createObject(), createObject('owner', parameters('owner'))), if(empty(parameters('costCenter')), createObject(), createObject('cost-center', parameters('costCenter'))))]
variables.featureSettings: [union(createObject('bastion', parameters('enableBastion'), 'windowsVm', parameters('enableWindowsVm'), 'linuxVm', parameters('enableLinuxVm'), 'natGateway', parameters('enableNatGateway'), 'entraLogin', parameters('enableEntraLogin'), 'shutdownSchedules', parameters('enableShutdownSchedules'), 'roleAssignments', parameters('enableRoleAssignments')), json(base64ToString(parameters('featureOverridesBase64'))))]

variables.jumpboxOutboundRules: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'AllowVirtualNetworkOutbound', 'properties', createObject('priority', 100, 'access', 'Allow', 'direction', 'Outbound', 'protocol', '*', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '*', 'sourceAddressPrefix', '*', 'destinationAddressPrefix', 'VirtualNetwork')), createObject('name', 'AllowAzurePlatformOutbound', 'properties', createObject('priority', 110, 'access', 'Allow', 'direction', 'Outbound', 'protocol', 'Tcp', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '443', 'sourceAddressPrefix', '*', 'destinationAddressPrefix', 'AzureCloud')), createObject('name', 'AllowEntraOutbound', 'properties', createObject('priority', 120, 'access', 'Allow', 'direction', 'Outbound', 'protocol', 'Tcp', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '443', 'sourceAddressPrefix', '*', 'destinationAddressPrefix', 'AzureActiveDirectory'))), if(parameters('enableNatGateway'), createArray(createObject('name', 'AllowInternetOutboundWithNat', 'properties', createObject('priority', 130, 'access', 'Allow', 'direction', 'Outbound', 'protocol', '*', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '*', 'sourceAddressPrefix', '*', 'destinationAddressPrefix', 'Internet'))), createArray()), createArray(createObject('name', 'DenyAllOutbound', 'properties', createObject('priority', 4096, 'access', 'Deny', 'direction', 'Outbound', 'protocol', '*', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '*', 'sourceAddressPrefix', '*', 'destinationAddressPrefix', '*'))))]

properties.securityRules: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'AllowRdpFromBastion', 'properties', createObject('priority', 100, 'access', 'Allow', 'direction', 'Inbound', 'protocol', 'Tcp', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '3389', 'sourceAddressPrefix', parameters('bastionSubnetPrefix'), 'destinationAddressPrefix', '*')), createObject('name', 'AllowSshFromBastion', 'properties', createObject('priority', 110, 'access', 'Allow', 'direction', 'Inbound', 'protocol', 'Tcp', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '22', 'sourceAddressPrefix', parameters('bastionSubnetPrefix'), 'destinationAddressPrefix', '*')), createObject('name', 'DenyAllInbound', 'properties', createObject('priority', 4096, 'access', 'Deny', 'direction', 'Inbound', 'protocol', '*', 'sourcePortRange', '*', 'destinationPortRange', '*', 'sourceAddressPrefix', '*', 'destinationAddressPrefix', '*'))), variables('jumpboxOutboundRules'))]

parameters.windowsAdminPassword: [if(variables('deployWindowsVm'), createObject('reference', createObject('keyVault', createObject('id', extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, variables('resourceGroupName')), 'Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', variables('keyVaultName'))), 'secretName', 'windows-admin-password')), createObject('value', ''))]
parameters.linuxAdminPassword: [if(variables('deployLinuxVm'), createObject('reference', createObject('keyVault', createObject('id', extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, variables('resourceGroupName')), 'Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', variables('keyVaultName'))), 'secretName', 'linux-admin-password')), createObject('value', ''))]
